description: Query Tongdaxin market data, screening, news, announcements, and research through its official MCP service.

auth.label: API Key
auth.description: API Key sent as a Bearer credential to Tongdaxin MCP. Create a key with data-service permission at https://vip.tdx.com.cn/site/app/pc-mall/main.html#/aiKey.

actions.name: call_tool
actions.description: Call one supported read-only Tongdaxin financial data MCP tool with arguments matching its live input schema.

toolName.description: The exact Tongdaxin MCP tool to invoke.

arguments.description: JSON arguments matching the live inputSchema returned for the selected tool.

inputSchema.description: Input for invoking one supported read-only Tongdaxin MCP tool.

result.description: The tool result. Structured MCP content is returned directly; otherwise the MCP content envelope is preserved.

outputSchema.description: The normalized result returned by Tongdaxin MCP.

includeProfessionalData.description: Whether to include inner volume, outer volume, order imbalance, and related professional fields.

includeFinancialData.description: Whether to include PE, PB, ROE, total market value, and float market value.

includeStatistics.description: Whether to include Tongdaxin statistical and ranking data.

statisticParameter.description: The Tongdaxin statistic selector used when statistical data is requested.

inputSchema.description: Input for a Tongdaxin real-time quote request.

baseInformation.description: Stable instrument identity and market metadata.

quote.description: The current price, volume, amount, and session snapshot.

items.description: One provider-defined row returned by Tongdaxin.

orderBook.description: The returned bid and ask levels.

financialInformation.description: Financial and valuation fields when requested.

statistics.description: Statistical and ranking fields when requested.

result.description: The complete structured MCP tool result, preserved for fields not covered by the stable convenience fields.

outputSchema.description: A normalized Tongdaxin real-time quote result.

actions.name: list_tools
actions.description: Discover the supported Tongdaxin market data, screening, news, announcement, and research MCP tools with their live input schemas.

inputSchema.description: No input is required.

name.description: The exact Tongdaxin MCP tool name to pass to call_tool.

description.description: The current tool description supplied by Tongdaxin MCP.

title.description: A human-readable title for the tool.

readOnlyHint.description: Whether the tool is expected not to modify data.

destructiveHint.description: Whether the tool may perform destructive operations.

idempotentHint.description: Whether repeated calls with the same arguments are expected to be idempotent.

openWorldHint.description: Whether the tool may interact with entities outside Tongdaxin.

annotations.description: MCP behavior hints supplied by Tongdaxin.

inputSchema.description: The current JSON Schema for the tool arguments, supplied by Tongdaxin MCP.

items.description: A supported read-only financial data tool currently exposed by Tongdaxin MCP.

tools.description: Supported read-only tools currently exposed to the connected Tongdaxin API Key.

outputSchema.description: The supported live Tongdaxin MCP tool catalog.

result.description: The complete structured MCP tool result, preserved for fields not covered by the stable convenience fields.

outputSchema.description: Resolved Tongdaxin instruments and the complete result.
